'''Nog''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. Nog occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], located closest to the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|Mandalore]]. Nog's close proximity to its sun rendered the planet a searing rock. After the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] forces of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] journeyed from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] to conquer the uninhabited planet that became [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="TEA" /> the newly renamed [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] spread out to conquer the planets of the surrounding system,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> including Nog.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nog was first introduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2009]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].
